QuestInfo.name: [Eluna] Maynard's Lesson: Bad Lands, Badder Monsters
QuestInfo.0: It's time for your next prospecting lesson!\r\nTalk to #p9400461#.
QuestInfo.1: You've finally made it to the Badlands!\r\nIt is a land rife with Elunite Crystals. There are even geysers that erupt, raining down crystals from the sky.\r\nBefore you go off looking for them, you should take caer of #p9400461#'s request and defeat 30 #o9402194#s and #o9402195#s!
QuestInfo.2: You were able to obtain much more valuable Elunite Crystals from monsters in the Badlands than from the Churmbles around the various Claims.\r\nNow that you've completed your lessons, explore Eluna to your heart's content in search of all the Elunite Crystals you can carry.

default.0: Your task is simple. Defeat 30 #o9402194#s and 30 #o9402195#s in the Badlands. This is your final test, so give it your all.
